chapter: Annex, Cadillac and the Ory-Oliver band
title: Who frequented 25s; Harry Wills and the Lala places
summary: Talk of the clientele of the district clubs, Harry Wills's manager, and the Lalas.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Who hung in the 25s? Who would be there? Who would hang out in the 25s? Other than musicians and women and men?
Well, that's the only ones that rank around that kind of place because the people that men with respect wouldn't go in them kind of places. They have their own places.
What about Wills? Would he go in the place?

Well, Harry Wills, sure he went in a place like that because the manager of the place was Arnold Doofusho that put up a lot of money on Harry Wills. And he was manager of the place. It was Lala's photo, John Lala's place. But Arnold Doofusho was the manager of it.
Do you know anything about the relationship between John Lala and Pete Lala? Were they?

No, no relation. There were no relations. No. Now listen, Pete Lala's name, he was not Pete Lala. It was Pete Sika Sika. But he just gave him that name, Pete Lala. Pete Lala, I think he was a relative of the trumpet player. Who? Johnny Lala was it?
Well, there's several of them. There's three Mike Lala's. I know three Mike Lala's. Tell about Tom Anderson. Tell now, tell us about Tom Anderson. What's that for you? Well...
